places.raw_name: the creek / the cave under the riverbank
places.name: Augustus and Pea Eye's creek dugout
places.note: Feverish and delirious, Augustus watches the flooded creek all night; at dawn the Indians have gone and he climbs out by a game trail on a makeshift crutch.
places.location_hint: prairie creek in Montana north of the Yellowstone, a little over forty miles northwest of Miles City

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus hobbles southeast across open prairie and collapses; old trapper Hugh Auld finds him, warns the leg must come off, and lends his horse.
places.location_hint: plains north of the Yellowstone, about forty miles northwest of Miles City

places.name: Miles City
places.note: Tied onto the borrowed horse, Augustus reaches a saloon at dusk and asks for a doctor; the horse bucks him into the street.
places.location_hint: on the Yellowstone, seen from a slope north of the river

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Augustus rides over a slope north of it and sights Miles City.

places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: In fever, Augustus imagines himself back with Clara there.
places.location_hint: Allen horse ranch on the North Platte in Nebraska

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Augustus dreams of lying with Lorena in their tent there.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus tells the trapper he hails from this small town on the Rio Grande.
places.location_hint: south Texas, on the Rio Grande

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Named as the river beside his home town.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus introduces himself in town as a Texas Ranger captain.

groups.label: Augustus
groups.hint: thrown into the street in front of a saloon at dusk, townsmen seeking a doctor

groups.label: Hugh Auld
groups.hint: on foot somewhere on the plains northwest of Miles City, following Augustus
